podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Parkinson's Diagnosis and Performance Impact (2000-Present)
podcast.body: Diagnosed with Parkinson's in 2000, Martha Johnson's condition has progressed to the point where she can no longer perform live. Despite this, she remains actively involved in music by collaborating and working with younger artists. "Martha was diagnosed with Parkinson's in 2000, which has progressed to a point where she can't perform live anymore, but she is still keeping her hand in things by working with younger artists."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Film Music Collaborations
podcast.body: Along with Mark Gane, Martha Johnson has written music for film, showcasing her versatility as a composer beyond band and solo albums. "She and Mark Gain have written music for film."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Pivoted to Children's Music (Mid-90s)
podcast.body: In the mid-1990s, Martha Johnson shifted her focus to creating children's records, a venture that earned her a Juno Award for Best Children's Album in 1996. "Martha Johnson pivoted to making children's records in the mid-90s. She even won a Juneil for Best Children's Album in 1996."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Long-Term Unmarried Relationship (Since 1981)
xref.body: Martha Johnson and founding member Tim Gain of Martha and the muffins have been together since 1981. Despite common assumptions, they have not married. "Martha Johnson and founding member Tim Gain together since 1981 and despite what you may have read, not married."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Ongoing Band Activity
xref.body: The band technically still exists and is currently managed by original members Martha Johnson and Mark Gane. "And technically the band still exists, run by Martha Johnson and Mark Gain."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
